Pipeline Team For Vets For Partners News Contact Get updates OUR PIPELINE Advancing the science of veterinary therapeutics. Building on medicines with years of human research behind them, we aim to bring selected programs to pets in significantly less time than a new animal drug typically takes. Every program is built for FDA approval from the start. Where a program may qualify, we also consider the conditional approval pathway. A diversified pipeline across high-need indications. We focus where human science is furthest ahead and veterinary need is greatest.
